mechanism: disposable working copy per mutation (scratch tree; original package never modified; pristine digest verified before/after)

mutations.name: publication_without_diagnostic_commit
mutations.guard: if the commit-receipt requirement is removed, an intended receipt with no state commit publishes

mutations.name: publication_base_state_check_removed
mutations.guard: if base-state validation is removed, stale-state intents publish

mutations.name: any_examiner_receipt_accepted
mutations.guard: if registry membership is dropped, a self-built receipt with the right examiner name registers

mutations.name: op_kind_verification_removed
mutations.guard: if the op check is removed, a wrong-operation Effect with the right payload passes
mutations.actual_failing_output: AssertionError: correct payload with wrong op_kind accepted

mutations.name: stale_effect_tick_accepted
mutations.guard: if the tick check is removed, an old Effect earns a fresh receipt
mutations.actual_failing_output: AssertionError: stale Effect earned a fresh receipt

mutations.name: consumed_receipts_omitted_from_seal
mutations.guard: if the consumed registry leaves the snapshot, the seal goes blind to it
mutations.actual_failing_output: AssertionError: seal blind to the consumed-receipt registry

mutations.name: split_sibling_cancellation_removed
mutations.guard: if cancellation is removed, an orphan sibling can run and publish top-level

mutations.name: cjtstep_snapshot_validation_removed
mutations.guard: if snapshot validation is removed, a stale step result is laundered into fresh intents
